summary: Spec fidelity (brief F1, spec 11.7 step 6; scenarios atip.checkorder.01, .02): a value outside a possibleValues set that stands before an unknown command word, or before a missing command word, does not answer; the later one does. Real binary: 'canon --as zzz nosuch' -> UNKNOWN_COMMAND field command, 'canon finding --as zzz nosuch' -> UNKNOWN_COMMAND, 'canon --as zzz' -> COMMAND_REQUIRED; the earliest failure on the line is --as, so USAGE field --as is required. 0.34 answers the same (not a regression), but F1 names the unknown command word as a failure to parse and asks for the earliest one. Cause: clap checks the subcommand before it validates the root's global --as value; earlier_failure reparses args[..at] and the prefix 'canon --as zzz' gives it no error. No scenario pairs a command-word failure with an earlier bad value (02 pairs it only with a later domain; 01 pairs --as zzz with an unknown option only). Blast radius: only a bad --as before the command words; every leaf-level pair I tried (enum value, wrong integer, missing value, stray operand, unknown option, both orders) answers the earliest.
